    Who is the new Texas basketball coach?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Sean Miller was named the 27th head men’s basketball coach at the University of Texas on March 24, 2025. A highly experienced coach with previous head coaching stints at Xavier and Arizona, Miller signed a six-year, $32 million contract to lead the Longhorns starting in the 2025-26 season. 
    Key Details About Coach Sean Miller: 
    • Hiring: Announced as head coach on March 24, 2025, after leaving Xavier University.
    • Background: Formerly served as head coach at Xavier and Arizona, with 20+ years of collegiate coaching experience.
    • Career Record:
      Enters the job with over 480+ wins, eight Sweet Sixteen appearances, and four Elite Eight appearances.
    • Contract: A six-year deal valued at $32 million, running through the 2030-31 season. 
    Miller, 56, was hired to replace previous staff following a chaotic 2024-25 season and was actively leading the team into the NCAA tournament by March 2026.
